serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: Damn! We were so busy talking we didn’t order any food! My time is running out!
You: Don’t worry about it.
Big Daddy: Waiter! Give me whatever you can serve me the fastest!
Waiter: O-ok?
Big Daddy: And for you?
You: I will take…
Since Big Daddy is paying I can order something I wouldn’t usually take…
You: …Tagliolini with lobster.
Waiter: Thank you very much…
Big Daddy: Oh man… Sorry Anon that it worked out like this, I really wanted to have a nice time with you, but you know, life is catching up. 
You: Don’t worry about it, it’s not your fault.
Big Daddy: Yeah, you are right. It’s not my fault! I will tell her that!
I think he misunderstood me right there…
Waiter: Sir, your soup is ready.
Big Daddy: Thanks. 
Big Daddy: Now that I think about it, I don’t remember the last time I ate soup.
Big Daddy: Taste is fascinating! It’s incredible what cooks can do with water and some…{{wi}} Uh…
Big Daddy: Do you know what that is? I didn’t care to ask.
You: Uh, I think that’s uh…{{wi}} Tomato soup.
Big Daddy: Tomato soup, huh. It reminds me of childhood memories. Not my actual memories, but a retrospective scene in some eastern european movie I saw once. 
Big Daddy: It was a pretty good movie, but I couldn’t pronounce its name so I kinda never recommended it to anyone.
Big Daddy: Alright Anon, I gotta go now or I’m fucked. Here’s 1000$, I have no idea how expensive this food is, but it should cover it.
